summary: Phase 19 is COMPLETE and device-verified. The Android-17 picker dead-end (previously believed an OS defect) was root-caused on-device to orbit's own intent: the USE_SYSTEM_CONTACTS_PICKER extra was set under android.provider.extra.* while the system picker reads android.intent.extra.*. Fixed in gap plan 19-20; the native picker now renders on the Pixel 6. Full 19-17 device UAT run (all 3 tasks PASS) and a fresh verifier verdict (PASS 4/4) followed. All commits LOCAL on main, NOT pushed.

resolved_blocker.was: Android-17 system contact picker non-functional on the Pixel 6 (ContactsPickerActivity -> 'No PreferredActivity Found' -> empty chooser).
resolved_blocker.root_cause: orbit set USE_SYSTEM_CONTACTS_PICKER under android.provider.extra.* (ignored) instead of android.intent.extra.* -> the trampoline read the flag as false and forwarded to a non-existent preferred picker. Device-state routes (pm clear, defaults, multi-user) proven dead; no OS update needed.
